title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with the containers:edit permission could import a container that includes…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where a user with containers:edit permission can import a container with a malicious HTML note. When another user views this note, unauthorized JavaScript may execute in their browser, potentially exposing data and allowing actions with that user's privileges. This occurs because HTML note content is not sanitized during import before rendering in Mission Control.
